items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: what impressed me about John Coltrane is, is that he sounded like himself... In my thinking, he’s upholding tradition.

ctx.x: See, this is, this is an approach I’ve been working on to replace the things that have become redundant...to me. Uh you can, one can talk up, like John Coltrane said, “Knowledge will set you free.”
